note: Both sets cover the same core facts (filter type, corner frequency 0.25 Hz at the -3 dB point, 0.0125 s time step) and both read the Bode plot at the same three frequencies, but each repeats several facts and states two or three conflicting values for the same point. Set A is slightly cleaner: it gives phase at 1.00 Hz as -75 and -80 deg, while Set B adds a third, -72 deg, whose own quote says -75. Both also state magnitude at 1.00 Hz as both -12 and -12.5 dB, and both use the figure caption as the quote for specific plotted values, which does not support them.
remarks: Both sets leave out the discrete-time state-space matrix definitions (A_d = alpha, B_d = 1-alpha, C_d = alpha, D_d = 1-alpha) and the relation of the corner frequency to the blade's first edgewise natural frequency as a stated condition. Chart-derived values at 0.10 and 1.00 Hz are approximate readings from the plot and the text layer gives only axis tick labels, so exact values cannot be verified; the -80, -72 and -12.5 dB claims are contradicted by their own quotes (which say -75 and -12). Repeated claims (phase 0 deg at 0.01 Hz and magnitude 0 dB at 0.01 Hz appear twice in each set) suggest the extractor emits both a caption-quoted and a chart-quoted variant of the same fact.
